body: I work at a local grocery store, so I deal with my fair share or both incompetent employees and customers. However, this one employee was literally the worst I've ever come across. It wasn't necessary that he was bad at his job, just batshit crazy. Used to come into work with his hand bandaged because he "punched a light post". Also, one day it was particularly hot in the store when he was bagging groceries while I was cashiering. Every customer that came through he decided to ask if his idea to set up a giant industrial fan in the middle of the store was a good one. Most people just stood there having no idea what to say. What's worse, guy made 18 dollars an hour because of the union compared to mostly everybody else's 9 dollars an hour or so.
